sloka: ममापि परमा प्रीतर्हते तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि ।रावणे सगणे चैव सपुत्रे सहबान्धवे ।। ७.४१.६ ॥
transliteration: mamāpi paramā prītarhate tasmindurātmani ।rāvaṇe sagaṇe caiva saputre sahabāndhave ।। 7.41.6 ॥

translations.english: He further said, "My supreme joy also arises from the killing of that evil-minded Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, and relatives."
translations.hindi: चतुभ्याऽपि समुद्रेस्य; सन्ध्यामन्त्ास्य रावण । इद्‌ मुहूत मायाति वाली तिष्ठ गुद्रतेकम्‌
